title: UMG Merge Specification Schema
description: Schema for merge operations. Same-type merges are auto-approved. Cross-type merges require a declared composite MOLT type and pass validation. A coherence_claim is required but not sufficient — validation must resolve independently.

MergeRequest.description: Input to the merge evaluator. Specifies what to merge and the requested composite type.

merge_id.description: Unique identifier for this merge. Convention: MRG-{DESCRIPTOR}.

merge_kind.description: same_type: all source blocks share one MOLT type. cross_type: exactly two different MOLT types. multi_type: three or more MOLT types.

source_block_ids.description: IDs of blocks being merged. All must resolve in the block registry or active session.

source_molt_types.description: MOLT types of source blocks in matching order. Populated by resolver — do not set manually.

merged_molt_type.description: Requested output MOLT type. For same_type merges, may remain the original type. For cross_type or multi_type, must be a declared composite type in the registry.

coherence_claim.description: Required. A human-readable claim stating why this merge is coherent. Evidence only — not self-authorizing. Example: 'The directive governs the instruction; the instruction executes within the directive boundary.'

merge_policy.description: How source block content is combined in the merged result.

requested_dominant_block_id.description: Optional. Requester's preference for which block governs in the merged result. Resolver may override based on vertical hierarchy.

MergeResult.description: Output of the merge evaluator. Appended to RuntimeSpec.merge_results and route_trace.

merged_molt_type.description: Resolved composite MOLT type. For rejected merges, records the requested type that was rejected.

coherence_status.description: coherent: merge is valid and internally consistent. partial: merge is accepted but one or more members are suppressed. conflict: merge is flagged for manual review. rejected: merge is invalid and must not enter RuntimeSpec.

validation_path.description: How the merge was validated. declared_composite_match: type found in registry and input types match. rule_validated: known safe pattern. sovereign_pending: plausible but needs MAG review. rejected: failed validation.

coherence_claim.description: The coherence claim from the merge request. Preserved in result for audit trail.

dominant_block_id.description: Block ID that holds authority in the merged result. Determined by vertical hierarchy unless overridden.

suppressed_block_ids.description: Block IDs suppressed in favor of the dominant block. Preserved in trace.

composed_fields.description: Composed field values when merge_policy is compose_fields. Key = field name, value = composed value.

conflicts.description: Conflict descriptions. Must not be empty if coherence_status is conflict.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the merge result. Required for all outcomes including rejection.

trace.description: Internal merge evaluation trace. Each step in the merge evaluation process.

KnownSafePatterns.description: Pre-approved rule_validated merge patterns. The resolver auto-approves merges matching these without registry lookup.

description: Top-level merge specification for use in sleeve JSON or merge preview requests.

mergeAcceptanceRules.rule_1: All source block IDs must resolve in the block registry or active session.
mergeAcceptanceRules.rule_2: All source MOLT types must be known base types or declared extension types.
mergeAcceptanceRules.rule_3: If source MOLT types differ, merged_molt_type must be a declared composite type in the registry.
mergeAcceptanceRules.rule_4: Every merge must include a coherence_claim. The claim is evidence, not authority.
mergeAcceptanceRules.rule_5: Conflict must not be silently ignored. coherence_status must be set and logged.
mergeAcceptanceRules.rule_6: Dominance must be traceable. dominant_block_id must identify the governing block.
mergeAcceptanceRules.rule_7: Suppression must preserve the suppressed block in trace output.
mergeAcceptanceRules.rule_8: The merged output must declare its runtime role via merged_molt_type.
mergeAcceptanceRules.rule_9: Rejected merges must return reason and must not enter RuntimeSpec active_blocks.
mergeAcceptanceRules.rule_10: sovereign_pending merges are held — not active, not rejected — until MAG review.

rejectionReasons.missing_declared_composite_molt_type: Cross-type merge requested without a declared composite type in registry.
rejectionReasons.incoherent_combination: Source blocks have fundamentally conflicting directives with no valid resolution.
rejectionReasons.unknown_source_block_id: One or more source block IDs do not resolve.
rejectionReasons.unknown_source_molt_type: One or more source MOLT types are not in base or extension set.
rejectionReasons.missing_coherence_claim: No coherence_claim provided for cross-type merge.
rejectionReasons.coherence_claim_insufficient: Coherence claim provided but validation did not confirm coherence.
rejectionReasons.merge_circular: Merge would create circular authority reference.

knownSafePatterns.description: Directive governs Instruction. Auto-approved. No registry lookup required.
Governed instruction applied to a subject domain. Auto-approved.

merge_request.coherence_claim: DIR-046 Honor Governance sets the authority boundary. INST-076 Check Governance Rules executes a specific check within that boundary. The instruction is a concrete action form of the directive.

merge_result.coherence_claim: DIR-046 Honor Governance sets the authority boundary. INST-076 Check Governance Rules executes a specific check within that boundary.
merge_result.reason: Cross-type merge auto-approved. Pattern DIR+INST matches known safe pattern producing GovernedInstruction. Directive governs. Instruction executes.
